summary: Provides a component-local timeline/clock that can drive timelines, Animation COMPs, or custom time systems, with playback rate, frame range, working range, looping, tempo, signature, and independent-clock controls.

key_params.name: play
key_params.note: Starts or stops the Time Component

key_params.name: rate
key_params.note: Frames per second for this time system

key_params.name: start
key_params.note: Start frame of the full time range

key_params.name: end
key_params.note: End frame of the full time range

key_params.name: rangelimit
key_params.note: Loop or hold when playback reaches the range end

key_params.name: rangestart
key_params.note: Start frame of the working range

key_params.name: rangeend
key_params.note: End frame of the working range

key_params.name: tempo
key_params.note: Beats per minute for beat-based timing

key_params.name: independent
key_params.note: Run independently of parent Time COMPs

key_params.name: clone
key_params.note: Clone-master source for the predefined Time COMP network

key_params.name: enablecloning
key_params.note: Enable active cloning from the clone master

key_concepts: Time COMP gives a component its own timeline or clock for Timeline, Animation COMP, or custom time systems.
Component Time requires the Time COMP to live in the component's /local network, normally as /component/local/time.
Play, rate, start, end, range limit, working range, signature, and tempo define the local time behavior.
Run Independently prevents parent Time COMPs from starting or pausing this local time system.
The default Time COMP network is cloned from /sys/local/time, and removing the clone path allows custom internal edits.
common_gotchas: For Component Time, the Time COMP must live in the component's /local network, usually /component/local/time.
Time COMP networks are cloned from /sys/local/time by default; remove the clone path before modifying the internal network.
Run Independently prevents parent Time COMPs from starting or pausing this time system.
Start and End define the overall length, while Range Start and Range End define the working playback subset.
Loop and Hold affect what happens at Range End, not necessarily the absolute End frame when the working range is smaller.
Reset Frame is obsolete and should not be used as a primary planner control.
Info CHOP channels expose fps, start/end, working range, bpm, signature, and play state for diagnostics.
build_relevance: 2021.10000+ component-local timeline and Component Time control
